name: tabee
description: tabEE — the tab exchange engine: capability discovery and user-approved dataset transfer between browser applications, with no backend.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tabee/protocol && npm run build -w @tabee/formats && npm run build -w @tabee/browser
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/newick-sender/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/tree-viewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-sender/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/hello-receiver/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run e2e
scripts.release: npm run build && npm publish -w @tabee/protocol && npm publish -w @tabee/formats && npm publish -w @tabee/browser
